Feedback received: Dashboard must make clear how workload is calculated.
What was changed: Connected Dashboard load to actual tasks through shared workload logic.
Why it matters: Judges can see the score has a reason.

Feedback received: Dashboard should remain a core feature.
What was changed: Kept Dashboard as the first warning screen.
Why it matters: It gives users a fast answer about current week load.

Feedback received: Balance should be used when the user is really overloaded.
What was changed: Made Balance a week-based overload repair flow.
Why it matters: It prevents Balance from feeling like random task management.

Feedback received: Care should be used when the user feels really stressed and needs to manage it.
What was changed: Grouped Recovery, Reflect, and Boundary under Care.
Why it matters: Emotional support is separate from task balancing.

Feedback received: Recovery should let users pick one reset.
What was changed: Added small recovery tools such as breathing, wooden fish tapping, and bubble popping.

Feedback received: Reflect should help users revise or understand pressure.
What was changed: Reflect asks one small question based on stress reason.
Why it matters: Users can identify whether they need rest, a boundary, or schedule changes.

Feedback received: Boundary should help users who do not know how to reject someone.
What was changed: Boundary generates soft, firm, or short replies from a written situation.
Why it matters: Saying no becomes part of workload protection.

Feedback received: The app had too many pages and priorities.
What was changed: Reduced feature emphasis and grouped care tools together.

Feedback received: If users dislike the app's suggested schedule, they should be able to reschedule.
What was changed: Added Edit controls on To-do List, Day plan, and Weekly plan.
Why it matters: The app guides without taking control away.

Feedback received: Users should be able to set reminders before tasks.
What was changed: Added reminder selection during Add task and Edit task.

Feedback received: Workload numbers across pages must not conflict.
What was changed: Shared calculation is used across Dashboard, Tasks, What-if, and Balance.

Feedback received: Dashboard should mean current week, not whichever week the user last selected.
What was changed: Dashboard current week is calculated from real current date.
Why it matters: On judging day, Dashboard automatically reflects that week.
